hints.title: Finite Overlap Geometries
hints.text: A path on a grid can cross itself in only three specific geometric configurations: intersecting 3 steps prior, 4 steps prior, or 5 steps prior.

hints.title: Lookback Window Conditions
hints.text: Examine step i against earlier segment lengths to determine if the path turns inward and collides with a previous edge.

hints.title: Three Case Evaluation Loop
hints.text: For i >= 3, check d[i] >= d[i-2] and d[i-1] <= d[i-3]. For i >= 4, check d[i-1] == d[i-3] and d[i] + d[i-4] >= d[i-2]. For i >= 5, check overlapping collar conditions.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of movement steps in distance array
complexity.notes: Optimal constant space geometric case evaluation running in linear O(N) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Storing and testing all segment pair intersections requires quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant lookback window of 5 steps avoids geometric line indexing structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the three geometric crossing patterns: 4th crosses 1st, 5th touches 1st, and 6th crosses 1st.
